title: JazzDeviceBundleV2Payload
description: The complete signed enrollment authority imported by a Jazz desktop client. Every identity, route, credential scope and live-compatibility value is present so an import can atomically replace prior enrollment state instead of inheriting an unsigned or stale field. The token and stream endpoint are secret-bearing and remain Keychain-only after import.

bundleId.description: Globally unique identity for this immutable signed reveal. A reissue or rotation mints a new bundleId; it never reuses one with different bytes.

generation.description: Monotonically increasing generation within one device enrollment. A client persists the greatest accepted generation and rejects rollback.

issuer.description: Out-of-band trusted Jazz enrollment issuer. The verifier compares it with local bootstrap policy; it is not its own trust root.

audience.description: Desktop enrollment audience expected by the importing client.

bundleExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the copied signed reveal. It cannot be later than the scoped credential expiry.

stackURL.description: Canonical Keboola Storage API origin that minted the scoped token.

archiveIngestURL.description: Canonical Jazz native control-plane collection URL ending in /api/archive-ingests.

token.description: One-time reveal of the scoped per-device Storage token. Never persist outside the platform credential store.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the scoped Storage token.

sinkBucketId.description: Exact single write bucket when tokenBucketScope is sink; explicit null when the verified permission map must be empty.

componentAccess.description: Exact component-access claim, sorted lexicographically before signing. Empty means no component access.

streamSourceId.description: Managed per-device Data Streams source id, or null for an archive-only/shared-endpoint enrollment.

streamEndpoint.description: Secret-bearing direct OTLP endpoint for liveCompatibility, or explicit null when live delivery is disabled.
